source: EU-Emotions stimulus set emotion definitions (O'Reilly et al.)

afraid.definition: to feel frightened, to have a feeling of fear

angry.definition: to feel extremely displeased, annoyed or hostile

ashamed.definition: to feel badly or embarrassed about yourself or your actions

bored.definition: to feel uninterested because something or someone is dull or unstimulating

kind.definition: to act in a friendly manner, to be considerate of others, thoughtful

disappointed.definition: to feel let down, to feel someone or something has not met one's expectations or hopes

disgusted.definition: to be severely offended by something or someone, to find something very unpleasant

excited.definition: to feel very happy and enthusiastic

frustrated.definition: to feel dissatisfied because one is thwarted in doing something or because one has no control

hurt.definition: to feel upset or in pain

interested.definition: to have one's attention held by something or someone

joking.definition: feeling playful, doing something to amuse others and make them laugh

proud.definition: to feel happy and satisfied by one's own self-worth

surprised.definition: to feel unexpectedly amazed or shocked

unfriendly.definition: to show disregard for someone or be unkind to them

worried.definition: to feel unsettled or anxious about something

sneaky.definition: acting in a secretive or deceptive manner

neutral.definition: showing neither strong positive nor negative emotion
